verses.text: Ix lolonxi Jehová t'a schaelal t'a winhaj Jonás chi'. Ix yalan icha tik:
Ixik lemnaj t'a niwan chonhab' Nínive, sb'at halan tas ol wal tik t'ayach, xchi t'a winh.
Yuj chi', ix b'at winhaj Jonás chi' t'a Nínive chi' icha ix aj yalan Jehová. Ha jun chonhab' chi' te niwan, ay am oxeok k'uhal stek'nab'il yek' yo'ol.
Ix och winhaj Jonás chi' t'a yol chonhab' chi'. Ha t'a b'ab'el k'u te cha'anh ix yal winh icha tik: Yik wal chawinak k'uhal tik ol satjokel jun chonhab' tik, xchi winh.

Masanil heb' anima kajan t'a jun niwan chonhab' chi', heb' icham anima yet' heb' unin, ix yak'och slolonel Dios heb' t'a sk'o'ol, ix och heb' t'a tzek'ojk'olal, ix laj yak'anoch pichul heb' ya swa'i. Icha chi' ix yutej heb' sch'oxanel skusk'olal yuj smul.

Haxo ix k'och yab'ixal jun tik t'a winh sreyal Nínive chi', ix k'e wa'an winh t'a sdespacho, ix yik'anel spichul winh yik sreyal, ix yak'anoch pichul winh ya swa'i, ix em k'ojan winh t'a skal k'e'en tik'ak'il ta'anh.

Ha winh rey chi' yet' heb' ayoch yajalil yet' winh, ix yak'elta jun ley heb' t'a masanil chonhab' chi', xchi icha tik: Malaj junok onh tzonh wa'i. Malaj pax junok onh skak' wa nok' ko wakax, ma nok' ko kalnel, max kak'paxlaj yuk' ha' nok'.

Ha tas ol ko k'ulej to ol kak'ekoch ko pichul ya swa'i yet' nok' ko molb'etzal nok' chi', yik sko ch'oxanel ko kusk'olal. Ol onh lesalwok t'a Dios yet' wal masanil kip, ol kaktankan masanil chukal sko k'ulej, ol kaktan ko mak'an heb' ketanimail,
talaj tzato sk'ex spensar Dios t'a kib'anh, tz'och wa'an yowal sk'o'ol, yik manh ol onh chamlaj, xchi jun ley chi'.
Ayik ix yilan Dios to ix sna sb'a heb' aj Nínive chi', ix yaktankan schuk b'eyb'al heb', ix sna'ani to manh ol satel jun chonhab' chi' icha ix yutej schekan alchajelok.
